clips.title: The story
paras: In Menethil Harbor, Sida lives apart from her estranged husband, Einar Stonegrip. She spends her days in the Wetlands port and sometimes ventures into the marshes, where she recently lost her bag near Ironbeard's Tomb.

Sida lives in Menethil Harbor, the Alliance port in the Wetlands, apart from Einar Stonegrip. Their marriage is strained, and Einar refuses to travel to Menethil while Sida remains there. She still sometimes ventures beyond the coastal settlement into the Wetlands. On a recent trip toward Ironbeard's Tomb, she lost her personal bag.
